description: Preview merging a library entry's latest version into a plugin, changing nothing: per kind the items it would `add`, those in `conflict` with the plugin (and whether they are `replaceable`) and the `identical` ones, the state of the rules, and the `entryVersion` and `fingerprint` that library_merge needs with decisions. Compare both sides of a conflict with library_item and the plugin's own tools. `entry` is the entry's exact name (matched case-insensitively, surrounding spaces ignored), or its id with `byId: true`; a value that looks like an id is still taken as a name without `byId`. `plugin` is required and is the plugin's exact, case-sensitive name, or its id with `pluginById: true` (see plugins_list); the installed plugin is never assumed.

byId.description: `entry` is an entry id, not a name (CLI: --by-id).

entry.description: Library entry name, or its id with byId.

plugin.description: Name of the plugin to act on, or its id with pluginById (CLI: --plugin). Required.

pluginById.description: `plugin` is a plugin id, not a name (CLI: --plugin-by-id).

name: library_merge_preview
title: Preview library merge
